title: `repeater` cell renderer hardcodes a Chinese count label (`{n} 项`) — violates AGENTS.md #-1 and bypasses i18n
body:
Filed by the objectui#8395 dev (branch `claude/issue-8395-copyfield-object-values`) while measuring the rendered text of every cell renderer on a detail row. ⛔ Not claimed. Out of scope there: objectui#8395 is about what the copy affordance WRITES; this is about what the `repeater` cell RENDERS, and fixing it moves no clipboard payload.

## What

`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, lines 2390-2395 (read at `ca3942729af817b3e017b8dcb99e1a4826a603f9`):

```ts
repeater: ({ value }: CellRendererProps) => {
  const n = Array.isArray(value) ? value.length : 0;
  return n > 0
    ? span with {n} 项
    : EmptyValue;
},
```

`项` is user-facing display text, hardcoded in Chinese, inside a standard cell renderer.

## Why it matters

Two rules, both broken by the same literal:

1. **AGENTS.md Commandment #-1 (English-only codebase)** — "All user-facing text (component labels, buttons, titles, errors) ... MUST be English." This is the exact class objectui#3342 (TagsField placeholder) and objectui#3736 (object-detail widget) were filed and fixed for; this site was missed.
2. **It bypasses i18n entirely.** Every reader on every locale sees `2 项`, including English ones. The neighbouring literals in the same table are English (`[Vector]`, `[Grid]`, and `FileCellRenderer`'s `N files`), so a repeater row reads as Chinese next to English siblings on the same detail page.

Note `FileCellRenderer` two hundred lines above spells the same idea `{count} {count === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}` — English, but also unlocalized and also not plural-safe for non-English locales. Whoever takes this should decide whether the fix is "make it English" or "route both through the field-translate channel the other renderers in this file already use" (`useFieldTranslate` / `useObjectTranslation` are both already imported here).

## Measured

Rendering a real `DetailSection` (happy-dom, `window.innerWidth` pinned to 1280) with a `repeater` field holding a two-element array:

```
--- stuff  (type: repeater, value [{q:1},{q:2}])
    RENDERED_TEXTCONTENT = "2 项"
```

## Dedup

`search_issues` once, self-validating (it returned objectui#7696, a live i18n card, plus the closed hardcoded-Chinese family). Sixteen results, none naming this file's `repeater` entry: objectui#3342 (TagsField placeholder), objectui#2264 (Studio surface), objectui#3736 (object-detail widget) and objectui#4028 (AddressField sub-labels) are the same CLASS at different sites and all closed. Nothing covers `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`'s standard-renderer table.
